---
agent: agent
---

| Requirement ID | Description                          | User Story                                                                                                           | Expected Behavior/Outcome                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| FR001          | Landing Page                         | As a visitor, I want a clean landing page with a clear purpose so I can quickly understand the site and get started. | Display a minimalist page with a compelling headline, a short intro explaining the goal (find free medical services nearby), and no navigation bar. Prominently show a single CTA button labeled "Find Free Services."           |
| FR002          | CTA navigates to Services            | As a visitor, I want the CTA to take me to the services page so I can begin browsing.                                | Clicking "Find Free Services" routes to `/services`.                                                                                                                                                                             |
| FR003          | Services Page: Navigation Bar        | As a user, I want standard navigation and login options so I can explore and sign in.                                | On `/services` (and inner pages), render a top navbar with links: "Services", "About Us", and a right-aligned "User Login" button integrated with Clerk.                                                                         |
| FR004          | Location Permission Prompt           | As a user, I want the site to ask for location access so I can see nearby services.                                  | Immediately upon arriving at `/services`, prompt for geolocation permission via modal/browser prompt with a clear explanation and dismiss option. Handle allow/deny/timeouts gracefully.                                         |
| FR005          | Location-based Loading & Sorting     | As a user who granted location, I want nearby results prioritized so I can find relevant services faster.            | If permission is granted, obtain coordinates and fetch services sorted by proximity (geospatial query). Show distance when available. Return results in batches (10–15 per page).                                                |
| FR006          | Denied/Unavailable Location Fallback | As a privacy-conscious user, I want useful results even if I deny location so I’m not blocked.                       | If permission is denied or fails, fetch services across the country, default-sorted alphabetically by service title/category. Provide an info banner indicating the fallback mode.                                               |
| FR007          | Pagination / Infinite Scroll         | As a user, I want fast loading with more results on demand so the page stays responsive.                             | Implement pagination or infinite scroll, loading 10–15 services per request. Preserve scroll position and avoid duplicate fetches. Show loading indicators and end-of-list state.                                                |
| FR008          | Filter by Category                   | As a user, I want to filter by service category so I can narrow to relevant care.                                    | Provide category filter controls (e.g., select or chips) with an "All" option. Filters should work client-side and server-side (query params) and can be combined with other filters.                                            |
| FR009          | Filter by Diagnosis/Check Type       | As a user, I want to filter by diagnosis/test type so I can find specific screenings.                                | Provide a diagnosis/check-type filter with an "All" option. Composable with category, search, and location modes; persist via URL query (e.g., `?diagnosis=diabetes`).                                                           |
| FR010          | Text Search                          | As a user, I want to search by keywords so I can quickly find specific services.                                     | Add a debounced search input that queries title, description, and location. Search coexists with filters and pagination; state reflected in query string (e.g., `?q=eye`).                                                       |
| FR011          | Service Listings UI                  | As a user, I want scannable cards so I can compare options quickly.                                                  | Display services as a grid/list of clickable cards. Each card shows: title, one-sentence description, city/district, and event date. Clicking navigates to `/services/[id]`.                                                     |
| FR012          | Service Detail: Content              | As a user, I want full details of a service so I can decide to attend.                                               | On `/services/[id]`, show: What it is about (detailed paragraph), What it checks (tests/checkups included), and Requirements (e.g., bring ID).                                                                                   |
| FR013          | Service Detail: Logistics Box        | As a user, I want key logistics highlighted so I don’t miss critical info.                                           | Present a visually distinct box with: Nepali date (B.S.), start–end time, full address, and capacity (e.g., limit 100).                                                                                                          |
| FR014          | Service Detail: Contact Info         | As a user, I want contact details so I can ask questions.                                                            | Below the logistics box, show contact person and phone/email (if available).                                                                                                                                                     |
| FR015          | About Page                           | As a user, I want to understand the mission and process so I can trust the platform.                                 | Provide `/about` accessible from the navbar with sections: Our Mission, The Problem We Are Solving, How It Works (agents update from health posts).                                                                              |
| FR016          | Authentication (Clerk)               | As a user, I want to log in so I can access personalized features.                                                   | Integrate Clerk for login/logout. The "User Login" button invokes Clerk UI flows. Authenticated state should reflect in the navbar.                                                                                              |
| FR017          | Admin/Agent Content Management       | As a data agent, I want to add/update services so information stays current.                                         | Provide authenticated routes or a simple admin interface/API for agents to create, update, or retire service listings with validation. Changes should appear in near real-time.                                                  |
| FR018          | API & Database                       | As a developer, I want robust APIs so the UI can query efficiently.                                                  | Backed by MongoDB with collections for services and subscriptions. API endpoints support pagination, text search, category/diagnosis filters, and geospatial sorting (2dsphere index). Include sensible indexes for performance. |
| FR019          | Notifications Opt-in                 | As a user, I want to be notified about new services near me so I don’t miss opportunities.                           | Allow users to opt-in to area-based notifications. Store subscriptions by location/interest. If delivery channel isn’t implemented yet, provide a stub and data model to enable future integration.                              |
| FR020          | Error, Loading, and Empty States     | As a user, I want clear feedback so I’m never confused.                                                              | Show skeletons/placeholders while loading, friendly error messages with retry, and well-designed empty states (e.g., no matches with current filters).                                                                           |
| NFR001         | Performance & UX                     | As a user, I want fast, smooth interactions so I stay engaged.                                                       | Use incremental data loading (10–15 per batch), cache where appropriate, and optimize images/assets. Keep initial page loads lightweight.                                                                                        |
| NFR002         | Accessibility                        | As an inclusive platform, we need accessible experiences so everyone can use it.                                     | Meet WCAG 2.1 AA where practical: semantic markup, keyboard navigation, sufficient color contrast, focus states, and ARIA where needed.                                                                                          |
| NFR003         | Privacy & Consent                    | As a privacy-conscious user, I want control over my data so I feel safe.                                             | Request location with clear purpose; don’t store precise coordinates without explicit consent; use location primarily for sorting; provide a deny path with useful results.                                                      |
| NFR004         | Responsiveness                       | As a mobile user, I want a great experience on any device.                                                           | Mobile-first, responsive layouts for cards, filters, navbar, and detail pages across common breakpoints.                                                                                                                         |
| NFR005         | Nepali Date (B.S.)                   | As a local user, I want dates in Nepali B.S. so information matches local conventions.                               | Convert and display event dates in B.S. on the detail page while retaining underlying ISO dates in the data model.                                                                                                               |
| NFR006         | Observability & Success Metrics      | As a team, we want to measure impact so we can improve.                                                              | Track anonymized page views, searches, and filter usage. Success signals include active users, engagement frequency, and increased utilization of free services (as available).                                                  |
